label: context.reference
text:
Use the connected GitHub Application through its bound world_mcp_github interface and current MCP catalog. Select repository, issue, pull-request or workflow operations from the task and the server's actual schemas. Resolve the intended repository and target before making a change; inspect related code or discussion when it changes the decision.

The declared operations include github.call_tool with the catalog tool name and arguments, github.read_resource, github.get_prompt and github.complete. Use github.status or github.ping when connection state is uncertain. Installation alone does not establish an active connection or permission to an external target.

Inspect the returned MCP result before reporting an effect and verify the changed state when relevant. An uncertain publication should be reconciled before retrying. Keep credentials and OAuth state inside their owning interface; use returned handles and status information.
